extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and academics who act as peer reviewers for F1000Research (prospective and current reviewers)
extracted.subtask_description: Information page describing the incentives and benefits offered to researchers who perform open peer review for F1000Research. Focused on what reviewers receive (credit, identifiers, metrics, discounts) rather than review-quality guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get credit for your work
rubrics_metrics.description: Your name and affiliation are published alongside your peer review report, allowing readers to acknowledge your contribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Open-peer-review publication of the reviewer's name and affiliation is the mechanism for attribution and recognition; this makes the reviewer contribution visible to readers and the community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work with others (co-reviewer acknowledgement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge the input of colleagues or mentor early career researchers and name them as co-reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers may credit colleagues or mentor/early-career researchers as co-reviewers, formally recognising contributions from others who assisted with the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get a Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for your review
rubrics_metrics.description: Add your peer review report to your ORCID record or cite individual reports to make them more visible and discoverable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each peer review report can receive a DOI, enabling reviewers to cite their review, include it in ORCID, and increase discoverability and credit for the review activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use our viewing metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: See how many times your peer review report has been viewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: F1000Research provides viewing metrics for peer review reports so reviewers can track readership and visibility of their reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Get a discount on your next article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you peer review an article for F1000Research you will get 20% off the article processing charge for one article you submit and have published in F1000Research in the next 12 months.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discount terms: 20% off the APC applies to one article, requires that the reviewer both submit and have the article published in F1000Research within 12 months of the review.
